moments.title: Premier League Sunday Showdowns
moments.blurb: Today sees a packed schedule of Premier League football across the UK, featuring Crystal Palace vs Liverpool and Manchester United vs Aston Villa among others.

angles.name: Match Day Build-up
angles.copy: It's Premier League Sunday! Who are you backing today? Liverpool head to Crystal Palace, while Man Utd host Aston Villa. Big points up for grabs!

angles.name: Key Fixtures Focus
angles.copy: Today's Premier League highlights: Crystal Palace v Liverpool and Man Utd v Aston Villa. Don't miss the action!

moments.title: Nottingham Forest Stun Manchester City
moments.blurb: Nottingham Forest secured a shock 3-1 victory over reigning Premier League champions Manchester City yesterday at the City Ground.

angles.name: Shock Result Reaction
angles.copy: Did you see that?! Nottingham Forest beat Man City 3-1 yesterday. Massive upset in the Premier League!

angles.name: Forest's Big Win
angles.copy: What a performance from Nottingham Forest! A huge 3-1 win against the champions. Where does this leave City?

moments.title: Wales in Autumn Nations Championship
moments.blurb: Wales kicked off their Autumn Nations Championship campaign yesterday with a win against Japan at Principality Stadium, and will face New Zealand next Saturday.

angles.name: Wales Win Recap
angles.copy: Great start for Wales in the Autumn Nations Championship! A solid victory over Japan yesterday. Now, all eyes on the All Blacks next week!

angles.name: Next Match Build-up
angles.copy: Wales look ahead to a huge clash against New Zealand at the Principality Stadium next Saturday in the Nations Championship. Get ready for some epic rugby!

moments.title: Exeter Chiefs Premiership Cup Action
moments.blurb: Exeter Chiefs faced Bath in the Premiership Rugby Cup yesterday at Sandy Park, and will travel to face Sale Sharks next Friday, November 13th.

angles.name: Chiefs Cup Fixtures
angles.copy: Tough one for the Chiefs yesterday in the Premiership Rugby Cup against Bath. Next up, an away trip to Sale Sharks on Friday!

angles.name: Looking Ahead for Chiefs
angles.copy: Your Exeter Chiefs are back in action next Friday, 13th November, taking on Sale Sharks in the Premiership Rugby Cup. Who's making the trip?

moments.title: Noah Kahan's UK Tour Continues
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter Noah Kahan brings his 'The Great Divide' tour to Manchester's AO Arena this Monday and Tuesday, before heading to London's O2 Arena from Friday.

angles.name: Manchester Gigs Ahead
angles.copy: Noah Kahan fans, get ready! He's at the AO Arena Manchester this Monday and Tuesday. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: London Calling for Kahan
angles.copy: Later this week, Noah Kahan hits London for multiple nights at The O2 Arena, starting Friday. A huge week for fans!

moments.title: Papa Roach Live in London
moments.blurb: American rock band Papa Roach are performing tonight at The O2 Arena in London.

angles.name: Rocking The O2 Tonight
angles.copy: Papa Roach are bringing their high-energy show to The O2 Arena tonight! If you're heading there, get ready to rock!

angles.name: London's Rock Night
angles.copy: Who's seeing Papa Roach in London tonight? It's going to be huge at The O2!

moments.title: Muse Take Over The O2
moments.blurb: Rock giants Muse are scheduled to play two nights at The O2 Arena in London next Sunday, November 15th, and Monday, November 16th.

angles.name: Muse Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Muse kick off two massive nights at The O2 Arena in London! Who's excited for some epic rock?

angles.name: London Rock Spectacle
angles.copy: Muse are heading to London next week for two highly anticipated shows at The O2. Expect a spectacular production!

moments.title: Jamie Miller Tops UK Chart, Thriller Resurges
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' remains at UK No.1 for a third consecutive week, while Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' made a historic return to the Top 5 on the Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Topper News
angles.copy: Still at No.1! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' continues its reign on the UK Singles Chart. And how about Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' back in the Top 5?!

angles.name: Thriller's Chart Comeback
angles.copy: 43 years after release, Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' just hit a new UK Top 5 peak! Halloween never truly dies, does it?

moments.title: Christmas Hits Return to UK Chart Early
moments.blurb: Wham!'s 'Last Christmas' and Mariah Carey's 'All I Want For Christmas Is You' have made their earliest ever re-entries into the UK Top 100 singles chart.

angles.name: Festive Chart Invasion
angles.copy: It's official: Christmas is coming! 'Last Christmas' and 'All I Want For Christmas Is You' are back in the charts earlier than ever before. Too soon or just right?

angles.name: Mariah & Wham! Are Back
angles.copy: Mariah Carey and Wham! have made their annual, but earliest-ever, return to the UK charts! The festive season has truly begun!

moments.title: Black Doves Season 2 Lands on Netflix
moments.blurb: Keira Knightley's acclaimed spy thriller 'Black Doves' returned for its second season on Netflix on Thursday, continuing the story of Helen Webb.

angles.name: Black Doves Binge
angles.copy: Have you started 'Black Doves' Season 2 on Netflix yet? Keira Knightley is back in action in the highly anticipated spy thriller!

angles.name: What To Watch
angles.copy: Looking for your next binge-watch? 'Black Doves' Season 2 dropped on Netflix on Thursday. Perfect for a weekend of espionage!

moments.title: Madame Blanc Mysteries Returns
moments.blurb: The fifth season of the popular cosy mystery series 'The Madame Blanc Mysteries' premieres tomorrow on Acorn TV.

angles.name: New Mystery TV
angles.copy: Cosy crime fans rejoice! The Madame Blanc Mysteries is back for Season 5 tomorrow on Acorn TV. Time to solve some new puzzles!

angles.name: TV Premiere Alert
angles.copy: What's on your watch list this week? The Madame Blanc Mysteries Season 5 premieres tomorrow! Who's tuning in?

moments.title: Manchester Christmas Markets Open
moments.blurb: Manchester's renowned Christmas Markets opened on Friday, transforming the city centre into a festive wonderland until late December.

angles.name: Festive Manchester
angles.copy: Manchester's Christmas Markets are officially open! Grab a bratwurst and some mulled wine, the festive season has begun!

angles.name: Christmas Market Buzz
angles.copy: Twinkling lights and festive treats - Manchester's Christmas Markets are drawing in the crowds. Who's planning a visit?

moments.title: Blenheim Palace Christmas Experience
moments.blurb: Blenheim Palace's popular Christmas Market and Illuminated Trail open this Friday, November 13th, offering a magical festive experience.

angles.name: Magical Christmas Ahead
angles.copy: Blenheim Palace's stunning Christmas Market and Illuminated Trail kick off this Friday! Get ready for some festive magic.

angles.name: Weekend Plans Ideas
angles.copy: Planning a festive outing? Blenheim Palace's Christmas experience opens Friday, November 13th. Lights, markets, and Cinderella!

moments.title: Happy 51st Birthday, Travis Barker
moments.blurb: Blink-182 drummer and rock icon Travis Barker will celebrate his 51st birthday this coming Saturday, November 14th.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: This Saturday, Blink-182's legendary drummer Travis Barker turns 51! What's your favourite Blink-182 track?

angles.name: Celebrating Travis
angles.copy: Happy early 51st Birthday to Travis Barker this Saturday! The man who brought us so many iconic drum beats.

moments.title: Neil Young Turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Canadian-American singer-songwriter Neil Young will celebrate his 81st birthday this Thursday, November 12th.

angles.name: Music Icon's Milestone
angles.copy: A true music legend, Neil Young, turns 81 this Thursday! What's your favourite song from his incredible career?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Neil
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Neil Young this Thursday! Keep on rocking in the free world!
